note: An ILLUSTRATION, not a record of anything that happened. No receipt carries consumption yet (contracts/receipt.schema.json has no field for it), so these three units are hand-written to show the shape and to exercise the one rule that matters: a unit of consumption is measured once and viewed through every intention that contains it. Read with `python scripts/sov_canon.py rollup contracts/fixtures/usage-attribution.example.json`.
why_these_three: asset.read-version is crossed by JOURNEY-04 and by JOURNEY-11, which serve different promises. That is the ordinary case that breaks naive rollups: one run, two journeys, four promises, and still one expenditure.
